title: Arrangement of the Three Realms
next_chapter_hook: When the gears of fate begin to turn, what answer will Chen Ji write on the final page of the Tianji Record?

text.content:
Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, twilight descending.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The surging tide of fate within the Tianji Record space had finally receded, replaced by an uncanny stillness. He looked down at his palm, the Heavenly Fate number flickering in his vision—seventy-three points, a full forty-five less than before entering the space.

This was the greatest consumption of his life.

Mountain wind rose suddenly, a sharp sword intent cutting through the void. Chen Ji didn't turn, merely shifting slightly sideways as a cyan flash grazed past his ear and pierced three inches into the ancient tree behind him.

"Your energy is in such chaos—are you playing chess with the Heavenly Dao?"

Su Qingyao's voice came from behind, cold and sharp, yet carrying an undercurrent of subtle anxiety. She landed ten steps away, her blue robes billowing, her brow furrowed with scrutiny.

dialogue.content:
"Just a minor deviation during cultivation, Senior Sister Su. No need to be alarmed."

Chen Ji turned around, wearing his usual timid smile, his tone casual as if commenting on the pleasant weather.

A deviation?

Su Qingyao冷笑一声："你当我是三岁小孩？方才那股气息波动，整个天青宗都感应到了——那是天机术的气息。"

Her eyes burned with intensity as she pressed closer, demanding the truth she sensed he was hiding.

text.content:
This question again.

Chen Ji sighed inwardly, yet noticed something different in Su Qingyao's gaze—less sharp than before, carrying an indefinable emotion. He suddenly recalled the visions from the Tianji Record—in this timeline, Su Qingyao would ultimately become his most steadfast guardian.

"Senior Sister Su," Chen Ji dropped his smile, speaking earnestly, "would you follow me somewhere? There's something I need to tell you in person."

dialogue.content:
"You're finally willing to speak?"

A flash of surprise crossed Su Qingyao's eyes before her cold demeanor returned. But she didn't refuse, simply folding her hands behind her back, waiting for Chen Ji's words.

text.content:
Inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, candlelight flickered.

After Su Qingyao finished listening to Chen Ji's brief account, she fell into a long silence. Night wind howled outside the hall, making candlelight dance and cast shifting shadows across her face.

"The Tianji Record... the Eye of the Heavenly Dao..." she murmured, repeating these words, her voice somewhat hoarse. "So from the very beginning, you were never a废物."

Chen Ji didn't answer, merely watching her quietly.

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao who had finally learned the truth, what choice will Chen Ji make?

choices.description: Reveal all the secrets of the Tianji Record, his own plans, and the consumption of Heavenly Fate to Su Qingyao, making her a true insider and companion.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the biggest trump card secret
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's complete trust, unlock the prerequisite for "Shared Destiny"
choices.risk_hint: Once leaked, it will lead to utter destruction

text.content: "Senior Sister," Chen Ji took a deep breath, making his decision, "at this point, I won't hide it from you anymore."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶得知天机录真相

choices.description: Only tell Su Qingyao part of the truth, preserving the most sensitive information like the Heavenly Fate consumption mechanism.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the existing dynamic of strategic博弈 while gradually deepening trust.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may detect the omissions and develop distrust.

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record is indeed in my hands," Chen Ji chose his words carefully, "but it's incomplete, and... every use comes with a price."

choices.description: Avoid answering Su Qingyao's probing questions directly, steering the conversation toward the upcoming final battle.
choices.visible_reward: Buy time and wait until the situation becomes clearer before speaking.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might temporarily leave, missing the opportunity for in-depth exchange

dialogue.content: "Senior Su," Chen Ji shifted his tone, "compared to digging into my secrets, there's something more important right now—the backlash from the Eye of Heavenly Dao is coming faster than we anticipated."

text.content:
Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, a bizarre purple glow suddenly blazed in the night sky outside the Council Hall.

That purple light stretched across the horizon, like a distinctive mark of the Demonic Path, heralding a message from afar. Su Qingyao's expression subtly changed: "Has the Demonic Path sent word?"

Chen Ji nodded, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes: "Ye Qing's people arrived three days earlier than agreed. It seems... she sensed something as well."

dialogue.content:
Before the words finished, a graceful figure drifted through the entrance of the Council Hall.

Purple纱 veil covering her face, demonic energy restrained within, Ye Qing's aura had grown several times stronger than when they last met. She first glanced at Su Qingyao, the corner of her lips curving into an amused arc, then her gaze fell upon Chen Ji.

"Young Master Chen, I've arrived ahead of schedule for our appointment. You don't mind, do you?"

"Demonic Path witch!"

Su Qingyao's sword intent surged wildly, green light shooting directly toward Ye Qing's throat. "How dare you set foot even half a step into Tianqing Sect!"

Ye Qing neither dodged nor evaded, merely tilting her head lightly to look at Chen Ji: "Young Master Chen, your Inner Sect senior sister seems rather unwelcoming toward me."

text.content:
The atmosphere within the hall suddenly tensed.

Chen Ji, unhurried, raised his hand and gently pressed down Su Qingyao's sword blade: "Senior Su, she's a guest."

Su Qingyao glared furiously: "Have you lost your mind? She's the Saintess of the Demonic Path!"

"She came to help us." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried an undeniable certainty. "This, I can guarantee with my life."

dialogue.content:
Hearing this, a strange glint flickered deep in Ye Qing's eyes.

She had encountered countless hypocritical pretenders with honeyed words and hidden daggers. Chen Ji's unadorned trust反而让她有些不知所措。沉默了片刻，她才开口，声音少了几分戏谑：「圣宗援军已集结完毕，共计三千魔修，随时可听候调遣。」

She paused, then added: "But the commander has made it clear beforehand—the dimensional fragments must be divided equally after the matter is settled."

choice.prompt: Facing the Demonic Path's condition for sharing dimensional fragments, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Though dimensional fragments are precious, the Demonic Path's combat power is indispensable; let's secure the ally first
choices.visible_reward: Gain the full support of three thousand demonic cultivators, eliminating worries about the rear
choices.risk_hint: If either party reneges afterward, it may spark new disputes

dialogue.content: "Deal." Chen Ji spoke decisively. "Though dimensional fragments are valuable, without Lady Ye's tremendous assistance, we might not even have the chance to see them alive."

choices.description: Propose new conditions: the Demonic Path provides personnel and effort, but dimensional fragments belong to Chen Ji's side, with other compensation to be given to the Demonic Path afterward
choices.visible_reward: Retain all dimensional fragments while maintaining the alliance
choices.risk_hint: If negotiations break down, the Demonic Path reinforcements will be lost

dialogue.content: "Lady Ye," Chen Ji smiled faintly, "dimensional fragments hold extraordinary significance for me. Perhaps we could try a different approach—the Demonic Path contributes its efforts in this battle, and I shall gift the Holy Sect with three treasures from the ancient forbidden realm afterward. What do you think?"

choices.description: Agree to equal division, but set prerequisite conditions: dimensional fragments are to be distributed only after the Eye of Heavenly Dao is completely defeated, and the Demonic Path must obey all commands throughout
choices.visible_reward: Both secure the ally and grasp the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path may consider the conditions too harsh

dialogue.content: "A fifty-fifty split is acceptable, but with one condition—until the Heavenly Eye is completely crushed, all actions must be under unified command." Chen Ji's gaze was calm yet profound. "What does the Night Saint Maiden think?"

text.content:
Just as both sides were negotiating, a commotion suddenly arose outside the Council Hall.

A Tianqing Sect disciple rushed in stumbling, his expression terrified: "Ch-Brother Chen! There's someone at the Sect Gate claiming to be... your sister who went missing years ago!"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Chen Nian. Why would she be here?

dialogue.content:
At the entrance of the Council Hall, a slender figure slowly walked in.

She was a young woman of about seventeen or eighteen, with delicate features tinged with pallor. Her eyes bore a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji's. Her gaze was hollow, as if she had seen through all worldly affairs, yet remained unmoved by anything.

"Brother."

Just one word, yet it froze Chen Ji in place.

text.content:
How many years had it been?

Chen Ji remembered the last time he saw Chen Nian—twelve years ago. That day, cultivators from the Holy Sect stormed into Chen Family Village and took her along with the other children from the village. He fought with all his might to stop them, but was struck by a palm and sent flying, watching helplessly as his sister was dragged into the darkness.

Twelve years of waiting, twelve years of scheming—all for this day.

But why would she appear here? A trap, or...?

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her voice grave: "The energy on her... it's a Heavenly Fate Key from the Holy Sect. I recognize it."

Su Qingyao also furrowed her brow: "Heavenly Fate Key? What is that?"

Ye Qing didn't answer, only looking at Chen Ji with a complicated expression: "Young Master Chen, your sister... she's probably not here on her own. The Holy Sect is using her."

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't speak.

He walked slowly toward Chen Nian, each step like treading on knife blades. For twelve years, he thought he had learned to be cold, to scheme, to bury all emotions deep in his heart.

But now, facing this sister he had lost and found again, he discovered his heart could still ache.

"Nian Nian." He stopped before Chen Nian, his voice somewhat hoarse. "Tell me, who brought you here?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian lifted her head, and a ripple finally appeared in those hollow eyes.

"Brother," her voice was soft, "they let me go. They said... as long as you surrender, we can be reunited."

She paused, a flash of pain crossing her eyes: "But I know you won't. So I escaped. I don't want to... become their bargaining chip."

choice.prompt: Faced with his sister's return and the Holy Sect's conspiracy, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.text: Protect her first, no matter what
choices.description: Chen Nian is Chen Ji's only remaining family. Ensure her safety at any cost, temporarily setting aside other plans
choices.visible_cost: May disrupt the entire strategic deployment
choices.visible_reward: Reunite with his sister, give her a safe harbor
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect may take the opportunity to strike

text.content: Chen Ji pulled Chen Nian into his embrace, his voice low but firm: "It's alright. Brother is here. From now on, no one will dare lay a finger on you."

choices.description: First comfort his sister, but immediately discuss with everyone whether this might be a trap set by the Holy Sect
choices.visible_cost: May make his sister feel alienated
choices.visible_reward: Avoid falling into the enemy's trap, maintain strategic initiative
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may misunderstand her brother's attitude

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gently patted Chen Nian's back, then looked up at Ye Qing: "Night Saint Maiden, you should know the abilities of a Heavenly Fate Key. Could you help me confirm... if there are tracking marks on her?"

choices.description: Before taking action, detailedly inquire about how Chen Nian escaped and the Holy Sect's arrangements, seeking weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence to provide basis for subsequent countermeasures
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may not fully understand all the truth

dialogue.content: "Nian Nian," Chen Ji said, supporting his sister by the shoulders, his gaze gentle yet earnest. "Tell me, what exactly did they say? How did you manage to escape? During your escape, did you notice anything unusual?"

text.content: It was deep in the night. The people in the Council Hall dispersed one by one, leaving only Chen Ji alone in the vast hall. The candles had burned out completely, only moonlight filtering through the window lattice, casting mottled shadows on the ground. Chen Ji stood alone before the window, gazing at the cold, bright moon in the heavens. In his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment emitted a faint, eerie glow. "Today's consumption was a bit too much." Mo Xiansheng's voice came from the fragment, carrying a hint of exhaustion. "Heavenly Fate Value at seventy-three points... barely sufficient, but should another unexpected situation arise..."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng," Chen Ji spoke, his voice so calm it was as if he weren't discussing his own life and death at all. "You say... if I were to die in this final battle, who would the Tianji Record choose?" The voice within the fragment fell silent for a moment. "Master, why do you ask this?"

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer. He slowly opened the Tianji Record, his gaze falling upon those densely packed prophetic visions. Every glimpse of the future consumed precious Heavenly Fate Value; every alteration of destiny brought heavenly backlash. His entire life, from waste to chess master, from chess piece to chess player—seemingly glorious, yet he had long since made light of life and death. But tonight, watching Chen Nian return, watching Su Qingyao and Ye Qing each taking their positions, he suddenly felt a tremor of wavering.

dialogue.content: "Master," Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly softened, "this old servant has followed you for so long, yet never have I heard you ask such a question." "Is it because you saw your sister today?" Chen Ji still did not answer. He merely closed the Tianji Record and said quietly: "Mo Xiansheng, you say... can the layout of my entire life truly break the chess game of the Eye of Heavenly Providence?"

text.content: Moonlight flowed like water, drenching the cover of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery: "Forget it, what's the point of asking these things? Regardless of the outcome, the path I must walk remains the same." He took out the Jade Slip he carried, carving several lines upon it: "If I can survive, the fourth possibility is to break the shackles; if I must die, I shall at least take the Heavenly Providence with me." This was his testament letter, and also his final gambit. Outside the window, the east had begun to glow with the pale light of dawn. A new day was about to arrive, and the curtain was about to rise on the final decisive battle.
